messages.message: Logging raw variable 'customer' risks exposing sensitive personal data (PII). Violates GDPR Article 32 (Security of Processing).
Request body parameter 'reqBody' uses 'any' type. Unconstrained payloads violate GDPR Data Minimization principles.
Logging raw property 'body' risks exposing sensitive personal data (PII). Violates GDPR Article 32 (Security of Processing).
Passing raw property 'body' to an outbound HTTP call risks unvetted third-party PII transmission. Violates GDPR Articles 28 & 44.
Query method 'find()' executes without explicit field selection, risking overly broad data retrieval. Violates GDPR Article 5(1)(c).
Request body parameter 'payload' lacks a structured DTO type. Violates GDPR Article 5(1)(c) Data Minimization.
Logging raw variable 'user' risks exposing sensitive personal data (PII). Violates GDPR Article 32 (Security of Processing).
Query method 'findOne()' options object lacks a 'select' property. Violates GDPR Article 5(1)(c) Data Minimization.
Data export endpoint 'exportData()' lacks authentication or security guards, exposing user data dumps. Violates GDPR Articles 20 & 32.
Entity 'UserEntity' lacks data retention or expiration tracking. Violates GDPR Article 5(1)(e) Storage Limitation.
Sensitive field 'password' lacks a hashing or exclusion decorator. Violates GDPR Article 32.
Sensitive field 'ssn' lacks a hashing or exclusion decorator. Violates GDPR Article 32.
High-risk field 'bankAccount' in entity is stored without encryption or column transformers. Violates GDPR Article 32.
Relation 'account' lacks an 'onDelete' of 'CASCADE' (or 'SET NULL'). May leave orphaned PII violating GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure).
Relation 'profile' lacks an 'onDelete' of 'CASCADE' (or 'SET NULL'). May leave orphaned PII violating GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure).
